name: i-dont-read-code
description: Plain-English mode for people who don't read code. Reports outcomes instead of mechanism, tags every claim with how it was actually verified, and says what's done, what needs deciding, and what only you can do.
localChanges: scripts/inject-rules.sh also finds RULES.md beside the scripts folder (vendored layout); scripts/session-start.sh also accepts the Chinese heading 「等你做的」 for Waiting on you. Keep both when re-syncing from upstream.
